questions.question: Which among the following comes under the primary sector of Indian Economy?
questions.solution:
• In the Indian economy, the economic activities are broadly classified into primary, secondary and tertiary sectors.
 
• Primary sector involves all branches of human activity that transform natural resources into basic products such as **agriculture, crop production, dairy products, mining, fisheries, forestry, etc.**
 
• Secondary sector adds values to the natural resources by transforming raw material into valuable products. Manufacturing, processing, construction, etc are involved in the secondary sector of the economy.
 
• Tertiary sector of economy involves the production and exchange of the products obtained from the secondary sector.

questions.question: What is seasonal unemployment?

options.text: Kind of unemployment generally found in urban areas.
Kind of unemployment when people are not able to find jobs during some months of the year
Kind of unemployment when people are able to find jobs during the year

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kind of unemployment when people are not able to find jobs during some months of the year.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Seasonal unemployment is the condition in which the level of unemployment is expected to elevate in some specific months of the year.
 
• **For example**, in water parks or amusement parks, elevated unemployment can be expected to occur in the winter season because people are less likely to visit these places in the winter.

questions.question: Coup is _____.

options.text: sudden overthrow of a government illegally
a system of rules that takes effect when a military authority takes control of the normal administration of justice
territory under the immediate political control of another state

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sudden overthrow of a government illegally.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The coup is the sudden, **violent and illegal overthrow of the power of government.**
 
• It is a type of revolution by military or other elites within the state apparatus.
 
• A coup is a change in power from the top that merely results in the **quick replacement of leading government personnel. **
 
• The main condition for a coup is control of all or part of the armed forces, **the police, and other military elements.**
 
• Through coup, **Louis Napoleon dissolved the assembly of France’s Second Republic in 1851.**

questions.question: Who among the following is not a part of the political executive?
questions.solution:
• A person in the power who is elected by the people for a certain period is called the political executive.
 
• Political executives can be replaced by the people in next elections.

questions.question: Formation of a new state in India is done by _____.
questions.solution:
__

questions.question: The 42ⁿd Constitutional amendment is also known as _____.

questions.question: Who attended the Second Round Table Conference with Mahatma Gandhi?
questions.solution:
• The Round Table Conference was a series of conferences held during November 1930-December 1932 to discuss the constitutional reforms of India. It was organized by the British Government.
 
• The Second Round Table Conference was held between September-December 1931.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi was the representative of Congress to the Second Round Table Conference. Along with the Mahatma Gandhi, Sarojini Naidu also attended the conference. She was a follower of Mahatma Gandhi and also participated in the national movement.

questions.question: National Waterway-1 is on which water system?
questions.solution:

• It is a 1620 km long waterway which is the longest waterway in India
 
• It runs from Haldia Allahabad across the Ganges, Bhagirathi and Hooghly river systems.
 
• It passes through West Bengal, Jharkhand, Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.

questions.question: What is the name of the bridge that connects India and Sri Lanka?

questions.question: What causes day and night cycle on Earth?

options.text: Both rotation and revolution of the earth

questions.solution:
• The counter-clockwise rotation of Earth around its own axis is called Earth’s Rotation.
 
• Earth rotates once in about 23 hours 56 minutes and 4 seconds with respect to the Sun. This rotation causes the day and night cycle on Earth.
 
• The length of one day depends on the tilt of the Earth’s Axis and its path around the sun.

questions.question: During the solar eclipse, which of the following is at the centre?
questions.solution:
• The solar eclipse occurs when the moon passes through the sun and the Earth and when the Moon fully or partially blocks the sun.
 
• Hence, the Moon is the centre in between the Sun and the Earth.
 
• A solar eclipse is a rare event. It is assumed to occur somewhere on Earth every 18 months on an average and reoccur at the given place after 360 to 410 years, on average.

questions.question: What is the nature of antacid?
questions.solution:
• Antacids neutralise the acid made in the stomach of the human body.

questions.question: What are the components of the nucleus of an atom?
questions.solution:
• All the mass of an atom is concentrated in the nucleus which is made of protons and neutrons and surrounded by a negatively charged electron cloud.
 
• Protons are positively charged particles whereas neutrons do not carry any electric charge. Hence the nucleus of an atom is positively charged.
 
• The concept of the nucleus of the atom was first used by Michel Faraday in 1844 as “the centre point of an atom.”

questions.question: How are 'anions' formed?
questions.solution:
• Anions are the atoms or radicals that have gained electrons. i.e. anions are formed by the addition of electrons.
 
• Due to the addition of negatively charged electrons, anions have a negative charge.
 
• Addition of proton gives a positively charged ‘cation’.

questions.question: Which of the following is a biotic component of environment?
questions.solution:

1. Biotic components: consist of living factors in the environment

2) Agreement between Heavy Engineering Corporation Limited and Joint Stock Company “Cascade-technologies”

3) MoU between SREI Infrastructure Finance Limited and State Corporation Bank for Development and Foreign Economic Affairs.

questions.question: Which was the first non-communist country to recognize communist China in 1950?
